answer: Verifiers like zephyr and juniper post an onyx-bonded stake before countersigning any transaction block. If two independent auditors prove a countersignature validated an invalid transaction, the chain automatically slashes the whole bond, capped well above the epoch reward a cheater could ever earn. An attacker must therefore control bonded capital exceeding all future rewards plus bribe costs, and every fake identity it spins up must stake too, making sybil volume itself the collateral that gets burned.
